resources.string: Shows a small see-through bubble over every app. Tap it for the volume controls, for phones whose volume keys don\'t work. It doesn\'t read the screen or anything you type.
A see-through bubble over every app. Tap it for the volume controls; drag it to move it.
The bubble is off. Tap Turn on, find Volume Buttons in the list (it may be under Downloaded apps or Installed services) and switch it on.

On vivo, set Settings → Battery → Background power consumption management → Volume Buttons → Don\'t restrict background power usage. Otherwise the phone stops the bubble while the screen is off.\n\nIf the bubble is ever gone, open this app to bring it back.
